summary: Phase 3 (h Gast-Verifizierung SMS+E-Mail, i Live-Chat Kunde<->Fahrer, j NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_PHONE + Parallel-Driver-E2E) implemented and verified. Providers: Twilio (SMS) + Resend (E-Mail), both lazy-loaded with mock fallback (same pattern as Stripe). Phone verification is MANDATORY before dispatch (POST /api/bookings -> 403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED without a valid token). Backend: 58/58 pytest GREEN (NEW test_phase3_verify_chat.py 9 + 49 prior) against a locally booted server; tsc --noEmit CLEAN. Two Node Socket.IO E2E suites GREEN: e2e_driver_socket.js (verify -> CARD authorize -> offer -> accept -> CHAT roundtrip -> driver:changeDest -> complete/capture) and e2e_parallel_drivers.js (two drivers: competitive first-accept-wins + offerCancel, then the full ONLINE_RESERVED_NEXT_TRIP loop from Phase 1b which was never socket-tested before).
action_items: Run 'prisma db push' in the pod after deploy – NEW models: Verification (channel,target unique,codeHash,expiresAt,attempts,consumedAt), ChatMessage (bookingId,sender,text). Booking gained relation messages[].
Run 'npm install' in the pod – NEW deps: twilio ^5, resend ^4.

Optional env: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN/TWILIO_FROM (SMS) and RESEND_API_KEY/RESEND_FROM (E-Mail). Without them everything runs in mock mode (code logged + returned as devCode). REQUIRE_PHONE_VERIFICATION defaults to '1' (set '0' to disable the gate). NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_PHONE shown in tracking when no driver is free.

IMPORTANT for the pod test run: the regression suite relies on devCode (mock mode). If a real Twilio key is set in the test pod, conftest.py can no longer auto-verify bookings and the pre-Phase-3 booking tests will 403. Keep SMS in mock mode for CI, or set REQUIRE_PHONE_VERIFICATION=0 for the test env.
critical_code_review_comments: h) src/lib/notify.ts (Twilio+Resend, lazy import, mock fallback) + src/lib/verify.ts (6-digit code, bcrypt-hashed, JWT proof-token bound to channel+target, 20m TTL, REQUIRE_PHONE_VERIFICATION gate). Endpoints /api/verify/request (upsert+send, returns devCode only in mock) and /api/verify/confirm (validates, attempts<=5, returns token). POST /api/bookings rejects with 403 code=VERIFICATION_REQUIRED unless verificationToken matches normalizeTarget('SMS', customerPhone). UI: BookingForm confirm-step verify-card gates the 'Taxi bestellen' button; token reset on phone edit.

i) ChatMessage model + Socket.IO chat:send/chat:history + emit chat:message to booking:<id> and driver:<id> rooms. Sender derived from socket role (DRIVER must own booking; CUSTOMER must be in the booking room). GET /api/bookings/:id/messages for history. Reusable ChatPanel.tsx mounted in TrackingView (me=CUSTOMER) and DriverPortal (me=DRIVER), gated to driver-assigned & not-ended.

j) NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_PHONE rendered as a tel: hotline card in TrackingView when trackingStatus=KEIN_FAHRER. e2e_parallel_drivers.js proves competitive dispatch (both offered, first wins, loser offerCancel, booking assigned to winner) AND reserved-next-trip (besetzt near-completion driver accepts -> RESERVIERT_FAHRER -> auto-promote to FAHRER_UNTERWEGS after current trip completes).

TEST DESIGN: backend/tests/conftest.py is an autouse fixture that monkeypatches requests.post to auto-attach a mock verification token to /api/bookings calls, so all 49 prior tests stay byte-for-byte unchanged. Opt-out sentinel _noverify:true (stripped before send) lets the Phase-3 negative tests hit the 403 path.

Two E2E bugs found & fixed while writing the parallel script (socket.io-client specifics, not app bugs): (1) multiplexed Managers for same URL -> added forceNew:true per socket; (2) attaching the 2nd driver's driver:state listener only after awaiting the 1st missed the event -> create both waiters before awaiting.

success_rate.e2e: 100% (e2e_driver_socket.js all checks + e2e_parallel_drivers.js all checks incl. ONLINE_RESERVED_NEXT_TRIP)
success_rate.frontend: tsc clean; SSR smokes 200 (/buchen add-stop, /fahrer). Verify-card + chat are client-interaction features fully covered by the socket E2E.
